SELECT COUNT(1) CNT,'DimAccount' as tables  FROM DW.DimAccount
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT,'DimAccount_grp' as tables FROM (SELECT AccountID
FROM DW.DimAccount 
GROUP by 
AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,ProfitCostCode
) A;


SELECT A.AccountSK
,A.AccountID
,A.AccountName
,A.AccountOpenedDate
,A.AccountStatus
,A.PayrollIndicator
,A.CurrencyCode
,A.BankSK
,A.BranchSK
,A.SourceSystemCode
,A.CurrentIndicator
,A.ValidStartDate
,A.ValidEndDate
,A.WorkFlowId
,A.TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
,A.ProfitCostCode
INTO DW.DimAccount_REMDUP_20230805_2
FROM DW.DimAccount A 
JOIN (SELECT AccountID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode, MAX(AccountSK) AccountSK, CurrentIndicator,ValidEndDate FROM DW.DimAccount GROUP BY AccountID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode,CurrentIndicator,ValidEndDate ) B 
ON A.AccountID = B.AccountID AND A.BankSK = B.BankSK AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK AND A.CurrentIndicator = B.CurrentIndicator AND A.ValidEndDate = B.ValidEndDate
GROUP by A.AccountSK
,A.AccountID
,A.AccountName
,A.AccountOpenedDate
,A.AccountStatus
,A.PayrollIndicator
,A.CurrencyCode
,A.BankSK
,A.BranchSK
,A.SourceSystemCode
,A.CurrentIndicator
,A.ValidStartDate
,A.ValidEndDate
,A.WorkFlowId
,A.TaskRunId
,A.ProfitCostCode;

SELECT * INTO DW.DimAccount_BU_20230805_2 FROM DW.DimAccount;

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'DimAccount_BU' as tables FROM DW.DimAccount_BU_20230805_2;
